acceptanceCriteria: A change to app/views/foos/show.html.erb selects request/system/feature specs with an advisory witness and keeps scope BOUNDED, covered by a test
RUBY-AFFECTED-V0 is amended; focused tests pass
body: Residual from V1-1795 (PR #1146). Non-Ruby templates under app/views (erb, haml, slim) have no owning adapter, so changing one gives UNOWNED_DIRTY_PATH and scope UNKNOWN. Request-spec selection also relies only on the app/controllers and app/helpers directory convention. Expected: the Ruby adapter owns app/views/** and maps a view change to request, system, feature and controller-type specs (advisory witness), else abstains with a named reason. Observed in PR #1146, 2026-10-18.
title: Ruby affected: app/views templates are unowned, so a dirty view gives UNOWNED_DIRTY_PATH / UNKNOWN
